login_description: Sign in to your family photo library.
login_retry_in: You can try again in {seconds} seconds.
login_pairing_qr_note: Pairing a phone by scanning a QR code arrives with the mobile app.
login_pairing_url_note: You can also sign in on the mobile app by entering this server's address.
nav_coming_later: The remaining sections arrive in a later update.
welcome_body: The web app skeleton is running. The photo views are on their way; the timeline placeholder pins where they will live.
shortcuts_pickers_heading: In the path and audience pickers
shortcuts_action_close: Close the open menu, dialog or list
shortcuts_action_step: Move to the previous or next photo
shortcuts_action_zoom: Zoom the photo in or out
shortcuts_action_exit: Close the info panel, then leave the viewer
setup_already_completed: Setup is already complete. Please sign in.
validation_failed: Please check your entries and try again.
internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_invalid_credentials: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
pairing_token_invalid: This pairing code is invalid or has expired.
asset_too_large: This file is larger than the upload limit.
asset_trash_move_failed: The file could not be moved into the trash.
asset_restore_move_failed: The file could not be moved back to its original location.
auth_forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
user_email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
model_download_failed: The model download could not be started. Check the server logs and try again.
model_invalid: This model cannot be used for the requested action. Check its files and activation state.
person_not_found: This person does not exist or is not visible to you.
album_not_found: This album does not exist or is not visible to you.
album_path_not_found: That folder does not exist. Check the spelling, or pick it from the suggestions.
album_path_not_directory: That path points to a file, not a folder.
album_path_not_readable: The server cannot read that folder.
album_path_in_managed_tree: That folder is part of the server's own storage and cannot become an album.
album_cover_not_member: The cover photo must be a photo in this album.
album_pref_not_excludable: This album cannot be excluded from your timeline.
album_deletable_not_directory: The deletion switch belongs to directory albums only.
tag_not_found: This tag does not exist or is not visible to you.
tag_name_taken: You already have another tag with this name.
timeline_empty: Your timeline is empty. Photos you upload appear here.
session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
upload_active_count: {count, plural, one {# in flight} other {# in flight}}
upload_conflict_body: A copy of "{name}" is already in the trash. Restore that copy, or keep only the new upload.
viewer_processing: This video is still processing. It plays as soon as it is ready.
viewer_trashed_notice: This photo is in the trash.
viewer_hidden_notice: This photo is hidden from the timeline.
viewer_faces_placeholder: No people recognized in this photo.
viewer_places_placeholder: Places arrive in a later update.
trash_note: Deleted photos stay here until their retention runs out, then they are removed for good.
trash_empty: The trash is empty. Photos you delete appear here before they are removed for good.
trash_remaining_days: {count, plural, =0 {Expiring soon} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
trash_delete_body: "{name}" will be deleted forever, together with its file. This cannot be undone.
favorites_empty: No favorites yet. Star a photo to keep it here.
hidden_empty: Nothing is hidden. Photos you hide stay out of the timeline and appear here.
admin_users_disable_body: {name} will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you re-enable the account.
admin_users_create_note: The new account can sign in and upload right away.
admin_models_note: The machine learning models this instance runs: detection, recognition, semantic search and text reading. The default group downloads once; custom models register from the server's models directory.
admin_models_slot_empty: No model registered for this slot.
admin_models_empty_body: The default model group has not been downloaded. Face detection, face recognition, semantic search and text recognition stay off until it lands.
admin_models_download_queued: Waiting for the download to start…
admin_models_download_failed_run: The download failed. Try again to rejoin the run; its own retries may recover it.
admin_models_activate_body_same: {name} becomes the active {slot} model. The previous model's products are kept -- switching back restores them -- but the new model needs a rerun over the library before its products appear.
admin_models_activate_body_cross: {name} becomes the active {slot} model with a different embedding dimension: every embedding is deleted and the vector column is re-typed. The whole library needs a rerun; switching back does not bring the deleted embeddings back.
admin_models_wiped_notice: Activated with the vector dimension changed from {from} to {to}: {count} embeddings were removed. Rerun the embeddings to rebuild them.
admin_models_rerun_title: Rerun this model over the library?
admin_models_rerun_body: One background run redoes {slot} for every ready image with the active model. Follow it on the task panel.
admin_jobs_note: The instance's background runs, newest first.
admin_settings_storage_note: The template every new upload renders its file placement from. The sample line shows where a sample photo lands.
admin_settings_saved_note: Saved. New uploads follow the new layout; existing files never move.
admin_settings_contract_note: Changing the template only affects uploads from the next one on: files already stored keep their paths, and nothing ever moves. Album variables stay empty for direct uploads.
albums_empty: No albums yet. Create one to gather photos around a moment.
albums_detail_empty: This album has no photos yet.
albums_delete_body: "{title}" goes, together with its photo list and its shares. The photos themselves stay in your library.
albums_remove_body: The album and its photos' library data will be removed — the source folder on disk stays untouched.
albums_timeline_note: Keep this album's photos out of your aggregated timeline.
albums_deletable_note: Off keeps the source files untouched — file-system deletions stay yours to manage.
albums_excluded_notice: This album's photos stay out of your timeline.
albums_cover_body: Pick a photo from this album.
albums_cover_empty: This album has no photos yet.
albums_create_report: The album was created. {count, plural, one {# requested member was} other {# requested members were}} not added.
albums_create_readonly: The album was created. This folder is read-only — its photos cannot be deleted through the app.
albums_path_hint: Choose an existing folder — the album references it in place; nothing is copied or moved. Typing suggests folders.
albums_path_required: Pick the source folder — an absolute path, like /Volumes/Photos.
albums_path_completion_failed: Could not load the folder suggestions. Check the spelling, or try again.
albums_audience_failed: Could not load the member list.
albums_rescan_failed: Rescan finished with some entries it could not resolve.
memories_empty: No memories yet. Select photos on the wall and choose "Add to memory" to start your first one.
memories_create_report: The memory was created. {count, plural, one {# requested member was} other {# requested members were}} not added.
memories_detail_empty: This memory has no photos yet. Select some on the wall and choose "Add to memory".
memories_picker_intro: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} selected — pick a memory, or create one.
memories_picker_skip_note: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} not visible right now and stayed out — a shared photo's visibility is re-checked at add time.
people_empty: Photos with faces will show up here.
people_unnamed_empty: Face clusters appear here once faces are grouped.
people_merge_into_body: This person merges into the one you pick. This cluster disappears and its name is lost.
people_edit_faces_hint: Every face in this photo is here. A face matched to the wrong person can be reassigned to someone else, or removed from the person it sits on.
people_detach_dialog_body: {name}'s face goes back to not grouped yet — the photo itself is unaffected, and it can be assigned again later.
people_detach_done: Face removed; it is back among the not grouped yet.
people_select_person_body: Who does this face belong to? Pick an existing person, or create a new person from this face.
people_create_from_face: Create a new person from this face
people_create_from_face_done: Created a new person from this face.
person_unname_done: Name removed; this person is unnamed again.
viewer_assign_body: Pick the person this face belongs to.
viewer_assign_note: This names the whole group: every face grouped with this one shares the name.
search_query_placeholder: Search your photos — words and meaning both work
search_result_count_so_far: {count, plural, one {# result so far} other {# results so far}}
search_result_note: Each filter's count shows the photos the other filters leave visible.
search_empty_body: Try different words, or clear some filters. Semantic search understands descriptions like "sunset at the beach".
places_head_sub: {cities, plural, one {# city} other {# cities}} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}
places_map_placeholder: The map view arrives with a self-hosted tile decision in a later update — the city grouping comes first.
places_empty_body: Photos whose GPS resolves to a city appear here, grouped by city.
settings_password_changed: Password changed. Your other signed-in devices were signed out.
settings_password_mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
settings_appearance_note: The interface language applies immediately. The installed languages are listed; contributing a translation adds more.
settings_download_note: Batch and whole-album downloads are packaged according to these preferences. Photos are always included.
settings_devices_note: A signed-out device needs to sign in again.
admin_settings_trash_note: Deleted photos enter the trash and are permanently deleted once the retention expires. Set 0 to delete immediately.
admin_settings_trash_saved: Saved. The next expiry run applies the new window.
admin_settings_trash_warning: Expired photos are permanently deleted together with their thumbnails and derivatives — this cannot be undone.
admin_settings_transcode_note: Uploaded videos are transcoded into a browser-friendly format. The original file is kept.
admin_settings_transcode_preset_off: No transcoding — store the original only
admin_settings_transcode_keep: Keep the original downloadable when transcoding fails
admin_settings_transcode_saved: Saved. Newly uploaded videos follow the new profile.
admin_settings_transcode_contract: Changing these settings only affects newly uploaded videos; existing transcoded copies are never regenerated.
person_birthdate_dialog_note: The birth date works out this person's age when a photo was taken.
person_avatar_dialog_body: Pick one of this person's faces as their avatar.
person_wall_empty_title: This person's photos are not here yet
person_wall_empty: Photos with this person's face land here.
